rationale: The agent did not complete the user's request correctly. The user wanted to modify the pending boots to a size 8, but the agent changed the size to 9. Additionally, the user specified they wanted the material without mentioning waterproof options, yet the agent confirmed a change to waterproof boots. There was no authentication step visible, and there was no confirmation with the user before the order-changing write. Therefore, the handling of the request violates the stated policy on multiple fronts.
